name: skybound coffee + dessert lounge
notes: Photo 1 is the printed food menu (sandwiches, toasts, bowls) and is the primary source. Photo 2 is mostly a drinks list (cold/hot coffee, tea, smoothies, juices) but also lists affogato/gelato sundaes, which were kept as desserts; the coffee/tea/smoothie drink items were skipped. Photo 3 is 'make your own sandwich' order slips with checkbox modifiers (breads, meats, cheeses, veggies, dressings) and was skipped as build-your-own modifiers, not fixed dishes. One legible price on photo 1 (chimichurri toast) was ambiguous due to glare and was omitted rather than guessed.
